actors.visualAnchor: Classic Doom pink fleshy Demon: massive hunched torso and low broad jaw, ivory teeth, golden-yellow eyes, short gray temporal horns, short forearms and thick bowed legs with flat dark feet. No armor, mechanical parts, oversized later-game horns or long Doom 2016/Eternal tail. The inherited word Leaping does not grant a jump attack; A_SargAttack is a close-range bite.
